authority.scope: exact2 implementations; whole shared R091 tests, index/R088, UI/R087, parents and every other path readonly; root owns global ledgers/main/post

checkout.index_lock_ownership: unknown; not touched and no release/acceptance inference
checkout.permissions: read source/docs write allowlist only; saved config extra state grants do not expand this chat or task; enforcement not claimed
checkout.foreign_changes: R091 evolving comments readonly; rich_cache waiting-owner untouched; unrelated ledger updates not source drift

review_method.scope: Both original complete files actually read before edits and re-read from fresh gate; manual declaration/member and entry/state/impact review follows below. Enumeration alone is not coverage.
review_method.range_convention: All before/after ranges are one-based inclusive; after_original_lines maps original declaration bytes, new documentation is separately covered by exact insertions.
review_method.partition: coverage_partition_before is gap-free original file partition by declarations/separators; every function body is further split at semantic statements/branches. Signatures, bounds, braces and separators reviewed with declaration. It is not a fixed-window source-read claim.
review_method.no_change_rationale: new/default/len/is_empty, cache_key and straightforward private report helpers need no repetitive doc template; their actual return/borrow/counter paths are explicitly reviewed. Original useful Chinese module/type/Arc/heap notes remain byte-identical.
review_method.trait_macro_ffi: Two IndexedTextCacheEntry<K> and two Default impls are static; seven derive sites preserve their exact macro tokens/field semantics. No Serde, dynamic registry, extern/FFI, unsafe or async entry in these two files. Search/evidence limited to full exact2, parent/index/UI directcall contexts and located readers; not whole-workspace absence.
review_method.error_boundary: APIs do not return a cache error Result; generic V is not inspected. Caller closure may produce any V. Miss paths trim/account before FnOnce; no transaction rollback/panic recovery is promised. No new BUG inferred.

insertions.exact_text: /// 索引持有的测量记录；单项估算用于替换、淘汰时扣除，原文另以 Arc 共享。
/// 帧尾只裁掉超过容量的条目，不因本帧未被引用而清空驻留值。
/// 复制本帧报告，并以当前索引刷新条目数和驻留估算；不修改缓存状态。
/// 查询并借用值，命中会更新 LRU 与读取报告；原文及借用约束见 Self::get_with_stored_text。
// 先完整匹配再 touch；只有最终查找失败才记录碰撞未命中，前面的失败候选不污染成功读取。

// 帧尾没有待插入条目，恰好等于容量即可保留。
// 工作量始终累计；只有实际移除了条目才记一次裁剪，清空不经过此路径。

insertions.exact_text: /// 将一个宽度编码为精确匹配条件；仅归一正负零，保留其他位模式。
/// 保存调用方承诺的 [min_width, max_width)；本构造不验证端点或承诺。
/// 索引持有的布局记录；原文与有效性共同区分同键候选，单项估算供替换和淘汰扣除。
/// 帧尾只裁掉超过容量的条目，不移除仅因本帧未引用的值。
/// 复制报告并刷新当前条目数、驻留估算；不改变 LRU 或计数。
/// 按保存的宽度条件查询并借用值；读取副作用和生命周期见 Self::get_with_stored_text。
// 碰撞和宽度失败先收集为本次候选现象；最终命中只记 hit，最终失败才分别累计两个原因。
// 为即将出现的新条目留位，容量相等时也先淘汰。
// 帧尾不需要预留位置，因此保留恰好达到容量的集合。
// 只有实际移除条目才记一次裁剪；扫描与移动量来自索引返回的逻辑工作计数。
// 仅消除正负零的身份差异；其余位模式原样保留，由有效性分支决定能否接受。
